people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

people.name: Ephesus
people.line: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.
translations.bsb: And you can see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but in nearly the whole province of Asia, this Paul has persuaded a great number of people to turn away. He says that man-made gods are no gods at all.
translations.kjv: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
